scopes.name: A/B makers
scopes.by: Javier ("Agibot and all the remaining makers with A and B")
rules: Batches of up to 10 new records, Agibot first.
Non-generative mask cutouts are authorised (Javier, 27 Nov 2026): alpha only, the robot's pixels kept; no part recreated, no generative image.

The whole platform or module the record identifies is shown, as the maker presents it (for example Axol's two-arm module), with no part added. A photo cropped to a bust or torso does not meet the whole-robot requirement. No model is assigned to a company record without one.
For a family record (A2, X2) one included variant may illustrate it, named in the alt text and provenance.
scopes.summary: 29 A/B records: 19 with an image (3 earlier, 16 new in batches 2 and 3), 10 still without a valid image after source review (no_valid_source). Not every A/B record has an image.

scopes.name: C/D makers
scopes.by: Javier ("sigue con los fabricantes de la C y la D, en lotes de 10, con fondo transparente y el robot de cuerpo completo")
rules: Batches of up to 10 new records; batch 4 then batch 5 with the rest that has a valid source. Models are never mixed to fill a batch.
Non-generative mask cutouts only, RGB faithful; no part generated.
Wheeled platforms and modules are shown whole, as the record identifies them, with no anatomy invented. A photo cropped to a bust or torso does not meet the whole-robot requirement.
Every record ends published and verified, or with a concrete stated limitation.

Exception to the no-props preference (Codex, 27 Nov 2026): an object the robot is holding in the official source stays as it is (DXTR carrying a box, Moxi holding a marker). Nothing is erased from the image or reconstructed, and no limb is cropped.
scopes.summary: 18 C/D records reviewed: 15 with an image (10 in batch 4, 5 in batch 5, DR01 with a resolution debt), 3 still without a valid image after source review (no_valid_source: Yogi 17, Darwin-0 134, Moya 174). Not every C/D record has an image.

scopes.name: E/F makers
scopes.by: Javier ("añade más imágenes"), via Codex, 27 Nov 2026
rules: Batches of up to 10 new records; batch 6 holds the ten eligible records (no separate batch 7).
Transparent background and the whole robot or platform; non-generative mask cutouts only, alpha only, original RGB unchanged; no part generated.
Wheeled platforms, arm platforms and modules are shown whole, as the record identifies them. A photo cropped to a bust or torso does not meet the whole-robot requirement.
No model is assigned by resemblance, and none is assigned to a company record without one (Eden 114, Flourish 129 need a decision first).
Existing E/F images (SE01 27, Figure 03 30, PM01 150) stay as they are; the Figure 03 quality debt is not fixed inside this count.
Every record ends published and verified, or with a concrete stated limitation.
Objects a robot holds in the official source stay as they are (Centaur-G1 holding a cup and a utensil); nothing is erased or reconstructed (as in scope C/D).
